title: Length bound for the certificate word
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $y$ be a finite bit string. Form a word by finding an $i\le |y|$ satisfying $i+C(i+1)^c=|y|$; if one exists, encode the first $i$ bits of $y$ together with the remaining suffix using the self-delimiting pair encoding, and otherwise take the empty word. The resulting word has length at most $2|y|+2$.
